item.title: Always log your entire configuration when booting
item.description: Here is a small tip that has saved me a lot of time: Always log your entire parsed configuration when your service or application boots. Or at least, support logging it through a verbose logging level. In practice, this can be logging the entire parsed YAML structure1, your config struct, or all the variables you have set from environment variables. No matter how you load your configuration, log it (but mask your secrets).

item.title: A maturity model for data-driven teams
item.description:
I recently read the excellent article Data is not a Strategy. It reminded me that I’ve been wanting to share some of my own learnings and thoughts when it comes to data-driven teams:

I was part of a big push to introduce service levels at my previous job. The objective of the project was to make our company data-driven when it came to operational excellence.
